The trace simulates a new strategy that plays C, then D on round 2, then C on round 3 to test retaliation, and switches to exploit mode if the opponent cooperates on both rounds 2 and 3; otherwise it uses a forgiving TFT mode. The trace changes the strategy by adding a naive-opponent detector and an exploit mode that defects while the opponent cooperates.

The trace simulates a modified strategy adding an early defection test, a naive-opponent exploit mode, and endgame defection. It changes the early-game forgiveness and naive detection thresholds to avoid false positives and DD loops.
